details: KPIs, and performance metrics in enabling data-driven product and digital transformation decisions
− AI-Powered Housing Finance Analytics | MBA Digital Technology Project – Analysed housing finance data using Python, Power BI and Excel
to identify customer, loan and performance trends, applied predictive ML and Neural Network classification for risk and decision analysis, and
developed a prescriptive AI approach to generate business recommendations.
− Salesforce Release Quality Analytics | Business Analytics & AI - Analysed Salesforce release data using SQL, Power BI, Excel and Python,
developing KPI dashboards for release quality and deployment performance, and applied Random Forest Regression and AI/ML techniques
to identify factors influencing release outcomes and generate data-driven recommendations.
